Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Namit Kumar
Present : Dr. Pankaj Nanhera, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Mr. Rajbir Singh, D.A.G., Haryana.
 **

The petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. seeking grant of regular bail in case FIR No.298 dated 06.10.2021 registered under Sections 419, 420, 120-B, 201 of IPC and Sections 66-C and 66-D of the IT Act at Police Station Sector 13-17, Panipat.
2.
Custody certificate dated 20.07.2023 has been filed by learned State counsel which is taken on record.

3. Learned State counsel submits that although the petitioner has given reference of one case bearing No.RC-DAI-2021-A-0032 registered under Sections 120-B read with Sections 420, 467 and 120 of IPC and Section 66-D of IT Act at Police Station CBI, ACB, New Delhi pending against him,
however, the petitioner is involved in 02 more cases i.e. (i) FIR No.556/2021 registered under Sections 201, 419, 420 and 120-B IPC at Police Station Sadar Bhiwani, District Bhiwani and 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:092464 2023:PHHC:092464 (ii) FIR No.310 dated 20.09.2021 registered under Sections 419, 420, 120-B IPC and Section 66-C and 66-D of IT Act at Police Station Dharuhera, Rewari.

sentences.text: 4. Faced with this situation, learned counsel for the petitioner wishes to withdraw the present petition with liberty to file a fresh one on the same cause of action with better particulars.
5. Dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as aforesaid.
